title: Infrawrench CI pipeline
description: A pipeline file in .infrawrench/ci/. Every job runs in its own WebAssembly isolate over a copy-on-write view of the commit's workspace.

on.description: When the pipeline runs. Omit it to run on every push.

schedule.description: Scheduled runs, in UTC, of the default branch. Each entry is five-field cron (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week; ranges, steps, lists, month and weekday names) or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly, @yearly. Jobs see event == 'schedule'.

workspace.description: The clone and dependencies every job starts from, built once per commit and shared, and the services every job starts with.

services.description: Services every job starts with. A job's own `services:` adds to them (one of the same name takes its place), and `services: false` turns them off for that job.

scratch.description: The most the run's shared /tmp/workflow directory may hold, as a size such as `2GiB` (16MiB to 16GiB, default 1GiB). Every job of the run sees the same directory; it is memory, and it is gone when the run ends.

branches.description: Branch globs. Empty means every branch. A pattern starting with ! excludes; the last pattern that matches decides, and a list that starts with ! begins from every branch.

paths.description: Run only when the commit touches a path these globs let through. A pattern starting with ! excludes; the last pattern that matches decides, and a list that starts with ! begins from every path.

depth.description: Commits of history to fetch: 1 (the default) or more, or `full`.

into.description: Where the repository appears inside the isolate.

deps.description: Dependencies installed from the repository's lockfiles before any job runs. Nothing executes install scripts.

dir.description: The lockfile's directory, relative to the clone.

only.description: pnpm only: install just these importers' dependency closure.

file.description: pip only: the lock to read, relative to `dir`, instead of `pylock.toml` or `requirements.txt`.

name.description: Display name. May use ${{ matrix }}, ${{ matrix.<axis> }}, ${{ commit.sha }}, ${{ commit.short-sha }}, ${{ commit.branch }}, ${{ repo.id }}, ${{ event }}, ${{ needs.<job>.outputs.<name> }}, ${{ needs.<job>.result }}.

matrix.description: A list (read as ${{ matrix }}), named axes (read as ${{ matrix.<axis> }}) whose combinations each become a job, or ${{ needs.<job>.outputs.<name> }} holding either as JSON. An axis may also come from an output.

oneOf.description: An output holding a JSON list.
An output of a job in `needs:`, holding a JSON list or object of axes. An empty list runs no jobs.

using.description: builtin:<name>@<version> (published tools), repo:<name>@<version> (tools uploaded for this repository) or env:<name>@<version> (a shell environment for `run:`). The version is a prefix: 7.1 takes the newest 7.1.x.

args.description: Arguments for a tool: a list, or one line split like a shell splits words (no expansion).

run.description: A bash script, for `env:` jobs. Runs with `set -euo pipefail`.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the isolate. Defaults to the clone.

clone.description: Overrides workspace.clone; false starts from an empty file system.

changes.description: What happens when the job changes files: ignore (default), fail, or commit them with a message.

needs.description: Jobs that must pass first: every matrix entry, or every package of a `packages:` job. In a `packages:` job, `^<job>` waits for that job in each workspace package this one depends on, and a `packages:` job's plain name means the same package's.

if.description: When the job runs. Operators ==, !=, &&, ||, !, parentheses and 'strings'; functions success(), failure(), always(), contains(), startsWith(), endsWith(), changed('glob', ...); names needs.<job>.result, needs.<job>.outputs.<name>, commit.sha, commit.short-sha, commit.branch, repo.id, event. Without success(), failure() or always() it means success() && (...). A surrounding ${{ }} is optional.

outputs.description: Names the job writes to the file at $IWCI_OUTPUT (`name=value` lines, or `name<<EOF` blocks), read by later jobs as ${{ needs.<job>.outputs.<name> }}. Not allowed on a matrix job.

paths.description: Skip the job unless the commit touches a path these globs let through. A pattern starting with ! excludes; the last pattern that matches decides, and a list that starts with ! begins from every path.

cache.description: Files kept between runs: restored before the job, saved after it passes unless key was an exact hit. Pushes read and write their branch's caches and fall back on the default branch's; pull requests never write where the default branch reads. Saves count against the owner's storage quota.

tools.description: Tools an `env:` job's script can run by name, such as `builtin:gofmt@1.27`. Each becomes a command named after the tool, first on PATH. Tools with the tsc-host ABI (`builtin:typescript`) cannot run as commands.

network.description: Whether the job may reach the public internet (default true). Never the runner's own loopback or private, link-local or reserved addresses; `false` leaves only the job's private loopback.

artifacts.description: Paths (relative to the clone, or absolute) whose files are handed on once the job passes: every job that needs this one, directly or through others, starts with them in its file system. They are not changes, count toward the run's `scratch:` limit, and may use `${{ matrix }}`.

downloads.description: Files kept for people to download from the run once the job ends: paths (relative to the clone, or absolute) whose files the job wrote, uploaded to the runners' object store and kept for `retention`. A list of paths, or `{ paths, retention, when }`. Text files have the run's secrets masked; binary files are uploaded as they are. Not for a task-cached job.

packages.description: One job per workspace package (from `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, or the root `package.json`'s `workspaces`): `true` for every package, or a filter. Each runs in its package's directory, reads `${{ package.dir }}` and `${{ package.name }}`, and resolves relative `artifacts`, `cache` paths and `task-cache` inputs against the package.

task-cache.description: Skip the job when nothing it reads has changed since a run that passed, handing on that run's artifacts, outputs and log. The key covers the job's definition, its input files, the lockfiles and the artifacts it is handed, so a change upstream reaches every job after it. Not for jobs that read secrets or commit.

services.description: Background services the runner starts in the job's isolate, on its loopback, before the job, and stops when it ends: added to workspace.services (one of the same name takes its place), or false for none.

paths.description: Paths relative to the clone, or absolute, that may use `${{ matrix }}`; a directory keeps every file the job wrote under it.

retention.description: How long the files are kept, between `1h` and `365d`, such as `7d`. Default `30d`. A runner may keep them for less (`--download-max-retention`, default `90d`).

when.description: Which outcomes of the job keep them: `success` (the default), `failure` (a test report, a crash dump) or `always`.

key.description: The exact key to restore and to save under. May use ${{ hashFiles('glob', ...) }} (globs relative to the clone, hashed from the commit), and the usual expressions.

restore-keys.description: Key prefixes to fall back on, in order, when key misses: the newest cache saved under the first that matches is restored.

paths.description: What to keep: paths relative to the clone, or absolute (such as /root/.cache/go-build).

only.description: Globs over each package's directory or name (`app/packages/*`, `@scope/*`), read in order; `!` excludes. Default: every package.

has.description: Names that must all be directly in the package's directory, such as `tsconfig.json`.

scripts.description: Script name to a glob its command must match (`*` matches anything, `/` included), such as `build: "tsdown*"`. A glob starting with `!` selects packages whose script does not match or is missing.

inputs.description: Globs of the files the job reads, relative to its package (or the clone); `!` excludes. Default: every file, `node_modules` never.

root-inputs.description: Globs relative to the clone that the job reads too, such as `tsconfig.base.json`.

service.description: A program that runs beside the job, in its isolate and on its loopback. Its name resolves to 127.0.0.1 inside the job, and its output is in the job's log, each line after `[service <name>]`.

using.description: env:<name>@<version> with a `run:` script that starts the service (env:postgres@18 is PostgreSQL), or a builtin: or repo: tool with `args:`.

run.description: A bash script that starts the service, for an `env:` service, such as `pglite` or `node server.js`. It starts in the job's working directory.

args.description: Arguments for a tool service: a list, or one line split like a shell splits words (no expansion).

env.description: The service's environment variables. ${{ secrets.<name> }} works here, and is masked in the log.

ready.description: When the job may start: one of `port`, `log` or `command`. Without one, as soon as the service has started. The job fails, naming the service, if it is not ready in time or exits first.

port.description: Something in the job listens on this port of the loopback. Nothing connects to find out, so a service that takes one client (pglite) keeps it for the job.

log.description: A regular expression (Rust's regex syntax) that a line of the service's output matches.

command.description: A bash script run in the service's environment until it exits 0. Only for `env:` services.

timeout.description: How long to wait, at most the job's timeout.
